author: customer_1
text: I cannot sign in to my Apple ID — keeps saying locked for security reasons. Need help ASAP @AppleSupport

author: AppleSupport
text: We're sorry you're locked out. Please visit iforgot.apple.com to reset your password and unlock your account. If two-factor codes aren't arriving, check a trusted device under appleid.apple.com. Let us know how it goes.

author: customer_2
text: I was charged twice for Apple Music this month. Pls refund the duplicate! On iOS 17.

author: AppleSupport
text: We're sorry about the duplicate charge. Review subscriptions in Settings > [your name] > Subscriptions and request a refund at reportaproblem.apple.com. Reply with the last 4 of the charge date if you need us to look further.

author: customer_3
text: MacBook fan is extremely loud even when idle. Is this normal?

author: AppleSupport
text: Some fan noise under load is normal, but constant high RPM at idle can mean dust, background processes, or a hardware issue. Check Activity Monitor for CPU hogs; if idle and loud, book diagnostics.

author: customer_4
text: Should I install the iOS public beta on my only phone?

author: AppleSupport
text: Betas can be buggy — we recommend a secondary device and a fresh backup first. You can enroll via beta.apple.com and leave the beta later by installing the latest public release.

author: customer_5
text: Cant download apps from the App Store — spins forever. Device: iPhone 13.

author: AppleSupport
text: Check your payment method, switch to Wi-Fi, restart your device, and try again. If it persists, sign out of the App Store and back in under Media & Purchases.
